title: Security Deposit Account Refund Channels and Unclaimed Refund Checks
content:
**Account status.** Refunds from a Security Deposit Account are issued only while the account is held, in move-out review, or statement issued. The status is read from the account's own record.

**Refunds from a held account.** A refund from a held account is made in only two cases:

- for a lease withdrawn before move-in, when the whole deposit is refunded;
- after a granted reduction.

A refund at final accounting is issued with the statement.

**How a refund is paid.** A refund is paid by ACH direct deposit only to an account the resident has enrolled. Otherwise it is paid by paper check, the program's default refund method.

**Uncashed checks.** A check still uncashed after the program's unclaimed-refund period is voided and handled as unclaimed property under state law. Resident services does not reissue it.

**Never refunded.** The guarantee premium and any other non-refundable amount are never refunded.

### Channel table

| Resident's enrolment | Refund paid by |
|---|---|
| Enrolled a bank account for ACH direct deposit | ACH direct deposit to that account |
| No enrolled account | paper check |

### Status table

| Account status | Refund may be issued |
|---|---|
| held (withdrawn lease or granted reduction only) | yes |
| move-out review | yes |
| statement issued | yes |
| pending funding, in collections, closed | no |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan household moves out owing nothing. The guarantee premium it paid is not refunded. A Standard Deposit Plan household with no enrolled bank account receives its remaining deposit by paper check. If that check stays uncashed past the unclaimed-refund period, it is voided and handled as unclaimed property. Resident services does not reissue it.
